༄༅/ /bde mchog drug cu ma'i mchod 'phreng bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// bde mchog drug cu ma'i mchod 'phreng bzhugs so//

༄༅// dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa// gzugs mdzes dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang*// me tog spungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tshigs bcad kyi thog mtha' gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' gnyis 'gre'o// yid 'ong dud kha rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// dhū pe/ kun snang dmar ser rdo rje dril bu dang*// mar mes gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// ā lo ke gdung sel ljang khu rdo rje dril bu dang*// dri mchog byug pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// gan+dhe/ zhal zas sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*// bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma// nai wi d+yā/ sgra snyan sna tshogs rdo rje dril bu dang*// pi waṃ gling bu rnga chen sogs 'dzin ma// shap+ta/ mthon mthing 'od chags rdo rje pi waṃ ma// rgyud mangs snyan pa'i skad kyi yid sgyur byed// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ badz+ra wī ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ rkang pa 'og ma gnyis dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra/ mchog gi gser mtshungs rdo rje gling bu ma// snyan 'gyur rin chen gling bu'i sgra dbyangs can// rdo rje rig ma/ waṃ she/ bim pa ltar dmar rdo rje rdza rnga ma// skad snyan lha rdzas bzang po'i rdza rnga 'khrol// rdo rje rig ma/ murañdze/ margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje rnga chen ma// rnga chen cher sgrogs nam mkha'i phyogs kun 'gengs// rdo rje/ mṛ taṃ ge pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan bzhad pa mo// 'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i bzhin gyis kun dga' bskyed// rdo rje/ hā s+ye/ mthon ka chen ma'i 'od 'dzin rab sgeg ma// rdo rje dril 'chang dkur brten snyems pa'i tshul// rdo rje/ lā s+ye/ btso ma'i gser mdog rdo rje glu dbyangs ma// shes rab dbyangs snyan rna ba'i bcud len mkhan// rdo rje/

gīrtī/ rma bya'i spu ltar sngo ljang gar mkhan ma// mnyen lcug yan lag mchog gis bro gar sgyur// rdo rje/ nṛ t+ye/ ston zla ltar dkar rdo rje me tog ma// lha rdzas me tog bye ba'i char 'bebs byed// rdo rje/ puṣ+pe/ sngo skya dud sprin rdo rje bdug pa ma// mkha' khyab dri zhim bdug pa'i spos dri can// rdo rje/ dhū pe/ gur kum gzhon nu'i lus can snang gsal ma// rin chen snang bas phyogs bcu'i mun sel byed// rdo rje/ ā lo ke 'char ka'i mdangs ltar dmar skya byug pa ma// legs sbyar dri mchog dge bas rnyog pas sel// rdo rje/ gan+dhe/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar gzugs can ma// rnam dag rin chen dngul dkar me long g.yob// rdo rje/ rū pa/ le brgan rtsi ltar lus dmar ro ldan ma// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha yi zhal zas 'dzin// rdo rje/ rā sa/ dur+war ba'i 'dab ltar ljang ser reg bya ma// reg pa'i bde ba mchog ster na bza' 'dzin// rdo rje/ spar+ṣe/ kun da ku muta rgyas 'dra chos dbyings ma// rgyal ba kun bskyed skye gnas phyag rgya can// rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis// he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dgyes mdzod// oṃ badz+ra dharmā dhā tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ mchod do phud thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rigs thams cad kyi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo/ rtsa rgyud kyi rje btsun bla ma dam pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he nas/ ya ma ma thā nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ pañtsa sogs sbyar/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/

gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong dang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ dpal ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ rnal 'byor gyi dgra lha/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ gtsug lag khang dang dkyil 'khor gyi srung ma chen po bya rog ming can legs ldan 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa la sogs pa dam pa chos skyong ba ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ gzhan yang yul phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa la sogs pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad/ 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad kyi zhal du pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ gsang mchod/ las kyi phyag rgya'i rab sbyor dang*// ye shes phyag rgya'i dmigs pa dang*// phyag rgya chen po gcig sbyor bas// 'phel ba'i mi 'gyur bde bas mchod// de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// bstod pa/ hūm̐/ zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang 'joms mdzad cing*// chos dbyings rnam dag ye shes ngo bo nyid// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor// zhe sdang rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ mchod rdo rje las byung char sprin mdog /dga' ba rnam dag drag po'i zhal bzhir snang*// gar gyi nyams dgus gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i// hūm̐ mchog rdo rje khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// rten 'brel bcu gnyis dag cing sa rnams rdzogs// bcu gnyis phyag gis mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// yul dang yul can rnam rtog gcod mdzad pa'i// ngo mtshar mtshon cha bsnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ gi nga ros srid gsum skrag mdzad cing*// rngam pa'i rkan sgra phaṭ ces sgra sgrog pa// bdud dang bgegs sogs gdug pa ma lus 'dul// rnam rtog bdud bgegs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// spros bral bde chen pad+ma rā ga'i mdog

/stong nyid 'od gsal dus gsum bde gshegs klong*// rnam rtog dra ba ma lus 'joms mdzad pa'i// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// sa chu me rlung 'byung ba rnam par dag /dag pa'i zhal bzhi rigs kyi yum du snang*// dran pa nyer bzhag ye shes ngo bo nyid// mkha' 'gro ma sogs yum la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems kyi rnam dag sa bla'i srid pa sbyong*// zhe sdang rnam dag thugs kyi 'khor lo snang*// thod pa'i dum bu rab gtum ma la sogs// gnas dang nye gnas bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// gsung gi nga ros sa yi srid pa bcom// 'dod chags rnam dag gsung gi 'khor lo snang*// myu gu can dang sa srung ma la sogs// zhing dang nye zhing bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku yi nga ros sa 'og srid pa bcom// gti mug rnam dag sku yi 'khor lo snang*// stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can sogs// 'dus sogs gnas na bzhugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// yang dag las mtha' 'tsho ba rtsol dang bral// bde chen dag la mos dang gtso la phyogs// gdug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i// sgo bzhi'i ma mor snang la phyag 'tshal bstod// brtson 'grus rnam dag yang dag spong ba bzhi// gshin rje sreg ma la sogs ma mor snang*// phyogs gnyis 'dzin pa'i sku mdog ma mo'i mchog /rgyal ba'i yum du snang la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs brgyad ni rgyal ba'i sprul par bstan// bdag med 'khor lo sprul pa brgyad du snang*// byang chub rten du shing brgyad mngon par byung*// 'jig rten chos brgyad sreg la phyag 'tshal bstod// bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba'i// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i pad+ma la ni rdo rjes rol mdzad pa// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig phyogs kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// rigs kyi yum bzhi dpa' bo'i phyogs kyi zhal la gzigs// pad+ma'i mu khyud gri gug 'phreng bas rnam par brgyan// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog

/bkra shis gang zhig mtshams kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la// byang chub sems dang tsan+dan gur kum dri chen chus// gang ba'i snod bzhi zhal gyi reg pas rnam par spyod// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig nam mkha'i dbyings na legs spyod pa'i// 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud rdo rje'i 'phreng*// gnas dang nye gnas la sogs dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig sa steng dag na legs spyod pa'i// 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud pad+ma'i 'phreng*// zhing dang nye zhing la sogs dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ngan 'gro'i gnas na legs spyod pa'i/ 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad mu khyud 'khor lo'i 'phreng*// 'dus dang nye 'dus la sogs dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med rol// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi mtshams rnams su// khā gdong la sogs lha mo yid 'ong gzugs gnyis ldan// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi rnams dang*// yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul dbang po stobs la sogs// byang chub phyogs chos sum cu rtsa bdun yongs rdzogs pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen pha gus mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang*// 'dod pa lnga yi longs spyod mchog ni rab tu bkod pa dang*// mu tig dra ba rin chen nyi zla gser gyi dril bu dpyangs// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig rta babs chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs kyis phub// mdzes pa'i ri dwags ba dan bcu drug legs 'phyar ba'i// rlung gis bskyod pa'i dril bu dag las chos kyi sgra chen sgrog

/bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs bskor zhing*// byang chub shing mchog brgyad ni rab tu byung ba las// sha za'i gdong can brgyad po dag ni legs gnas pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes me chen brgyad ni 'bar bar gyur pa dang*// byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sprin chen brgyad ni 'dus par gyur pa la// dga' bo la sogs klu chen sde bcas brgyad po dag ni legs gnas pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig thugs rje'i rang bzhin chu chen brgyad ni 'bab par gyur pa dang*// brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong brgyad po rnams kyis rab tu bskor gyur cing*// rnal 'byor pa dang rnal 'byor ma ni dur khrod rnams kyi nang na mdzes// bden pa des kyang bde ba mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /yid las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pra wa ra sat+ka rā ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhabs bsil phul/ hā yan 'dra/ ar+ghaṃ ma ma tat+t+raṃ/ gṛh+ṇa sid+dhi me pra/ mchod yon/ hi sa tuṅka/ lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar// lha yi dri yis nye bar byugs// me tog bzang po 'di bzhes la// gnas 'di nyid du bzhugs su gsol// puṣ+pe/ tsan+dan gur kum sbyar ba yi// dri mchog bdug spos dam pa 'di// dbang po'i sgo rnams tshim pa'i mchog /byin gyis rlobs la bzhes su gsol// dhū pe/ mar me 'od bzang 'bar ba 'di// ngan 'gro'i mun pa 'joms byed cing*// lha yi mig 'byed dam pa 'di// bdag la dgongs te bzhes su gsol// dī paṃ/ sna tshogs lha yi dri dang ldan// sna tshogs ga pur gyis ni brgyan// sna tshogs hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// dri mchog 'di dag bzhes su gsol// gan+dhe/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa// bza' ba'i bye brag sna tshogs pa// zhal zas thams cad phun sum tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// nai wi d+ye/

bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i 'phrul// pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga can// brgyad gnyis lang tsho dpal 'bras nu 'bur ma// bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma// nya rgyas zla ba dag pa'i bzhin ras ma// tshim zhing gsal ba bdud rtsi'i 'od ldan ma// rdo rje rig ma lha mos deng mchod na// mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i mchog sbyin mdzod// wī ne sogs 'gre/ bde mchog rgod dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs bro gar mkhan// zur mig 'phen mkhas 'dod pa'i mda' 'phen ma// 'chi med na chung sgyu ma'i 'jo sgeg ma// yid 'phrog dpa' mo rdo rje'i glu dbyangs ma// 'gying gzugs glog 'dra gar dgu'i rtsed 'jo ma// rdo rje/ bde mchog me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog 'dzin// rnam rgyas pad dkar gzhon nu'i zhal mdzes ma// dri zhim ma li gsar pa'i dri ldan ma// mtshar sdug 'od kyis phyogs cha rnams 'gengs ma// ga pur tsan+dan shing ltar gdung sel ma// rdo rje/ bde mchog gzugs bcud reg bya chos kyi lha mo ni// mdzes sdug dpe byad bzang po'i dpal ldan ma// ma mchu bdud rtsis gtsang ma'i ro ldan ma// reg byas dbang po kun nas tshim byed ma// bsam yas lhan cig skyes dga'i 'byung gnas ma// rdo rje/ bde mchog sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ rkang pa brgyad pas bstod de gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ gzhan rang rang gi snying po bdun bdun bzla/ sngags 'phreng gzungs thag la 'khril/ de rnam rgyal chen po'i lha rnams kyi thugs khar zhugs pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu/ de bum par blugs pas de'i lha thams cad kyang bdud rtsi'i ngo bor ltem gyis song*/ bdag 'jug 'dir len/ gzhan la dbang bskur ba dang rab tu gnas pa sogs kyang mtshams 'dir bya'o// tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am ston mo gnyis gang byed kyang rung*/ bdag bskyed bzhin gtor ma btang*/

tshogs kyi bdag po'i mdun du stag la sogs pa'i g.yang gzhi'i steng du chang dang bza' ba rnams bshams te/ bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gis bsang gtor byas la/ de nas lag pa g.yon bkab oṃ yig gis sbyang bar bya'o// lag pa g.yas bkab āḥyig gis rtogs par bya'o// snyim pa bkab ste hūm̐ yig gis sbar bar bya'o// mkha' lding gi phyag rgya dang hoḥyig gis bdud rtsir bya zhing*/ hūm̐ dbyings srid zhi kun tu 'char ba'i ma// dpal rdo rje yan lag ma mo'i 'phrul// mtshan kun ldan ye shes ka pā la// de bsam gyis mi khyab nam mkha' tsam// ā ra li rnal 'byor gyi 'dus pa la// 'dod yon gyi longs spyod mi zad pa// ha hoḥhrīḥkha dog dri ro'i tshogs// mchog rnam pa kun ldan stong pa'i dpyid// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyangs rtogs sbar bas na// dpal mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i gnas// sa ha dza so so rang rig gis// kha sbyor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bsdam// zhes byin gyis brlabs te/ chang gi thig les g.yon pa'i ming med kyi rtse mos sa la chos 'byung gru gsum byas la/ de'i dbus su thig le ltar zlum por bskor la/ hūm̐ thugs zung 'jug rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// gsung chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad pa// sku rnam pa kun ldan tshogs kyi mchog /skyabs gsum gyi 'dus pa bla ma rje// 'khor brgyud pa'i bla ma nyi li li// sku mdzes pa'i rus rgyan khro lo lo// gsung theg chen chos sgra 'u ru ru// thugs dgyes pa'i gar stabs ling nge nge*// nged bu slob tshogs kyi dpon la gshegs// bcud dam rdzas 'di la byin rlabs zhu// mchog thun mong dngos grub stsal nas kyang*// yab khyed dang mnyam pa'i dngos grub zhu// dkyil 'khor gyi pad+ma'i snying po kun// ris med pa rgyal ba'i ze'u 'brus bkang*// dngos grub kyi zil mngar ci dang ci// yid bzhin du 'byung ba lhag pa'i lha// 'khor yi dam lha tshogs nyi li li// lha khyed dang bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra// nang ye shes nyi ma zla ba'i rdzu// bar chad kyi mun pa mthar byed cing*// yid skyob kyi snang ba kun ston pa// yum rdo rje btsun mo rigs lnga'i sde// 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyi li li// ma/

khong bdud bzhi'i g.yul ngo rlag byed du// dpal rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i snying rje'i stobs// lha mi bzad khros pa dpa' bo'i sde// mgon ma hā kā la lcam dral la// 'khor dregs pa'i lha srin nyi li li// mgon khyed dang bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra// zhes spyan drangs nas/ chos 'byung nam mkha'i khams khyab pa tsam du song ba'i steng gi char bla ma/ 'og gi char yi dam bsgom pa bzhin la gsang sngags kyi lha thams cad gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro ma/ 'og tu dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma zhing skyong pho mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsam la/ las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum btsal/ tshogs phud dang po 'bul ba la thug gtad par zhu byas la/ hūm̐ rje srid zhi'i phan pa thams cad du// chu zla bzhin 'gog pa med shar ba// dpal dang po'i mgon po bla ma'i zhabs// bka' brgyud kyi rje btsun rgya mtsho la// mi bdag gi lus dge longs spyod kun// sngags gsang ba chen po'i dam tshig rdzas// ci spyad kyang mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod// 'dod yon gyi dpyid du sbar te 'bul// tshogs gnyis kyi lang tshos rab gang zhing*// sgrib gnyis kyi sprin las rnam grol ba'i// dpal kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer ni// nam mkha' srid 'gengs pa'i nus pa zhu// tshogs phud gnyis pa la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs la ga ṇa tsa kra pū dza khā hi btags pas dkyil 'khor la phul/ gsum pa la/ hūm̐ zhi ba dang khro chags thams cad pa// sgyu 'phrul gyi zlos gar la shar nas// dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i mgon mdzad pa// yi dam gyi lha tshogs rgya mtsho la// de man sngar bzhin gyis phul/ bzhi pa/ hūm̐ 'khor 'das kyi ngo mtshar ma lus pa// gnyis med las gnyis su ston byed pa'i// sras rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum// dpa' bo dang ḍā ki rgya mtsho la// lnga pa la/ bdud tshogs la bdud dang chos par gnyen// snying rje las rnam pa thams cad pa// khrag 'thung gi rgyal po dga' mar bcas// dam can gyi chos skyong rgya mtsho la// zhes pas phul// yul de'i zhing skyong dang grong gi bdag po la// oṃ yig dang dbus su ming dang*/

mthar āḥhūm̐ che ge mo i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa sarba sa twa nāṃ shān+tiṃ tsit+ta ku ru ku ru swā hā/ dbus su ming zhes pa/ de dag gi ming 'bru bzhi yod na mnyam pas yi ge dang po ming yin pas de 'jug gsum na mi mnyam pa la gsum pa ming du 'gyur bas de 'jug pa yin no// des 'gre'o// oṃ hā rī ti piṇ+ḍa ke pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'phrog ma'i changs bu'i sngags/ oṃ dū tī ke a grā gra saṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bsngags nas bza' ba'i mtha' ji srid pa la bzhag go /de nas las kyi rdo rjes bza' ba sder du 'bul zhing btung ba pad+ma'i snod du phul te bskor ba gsum byas nas/ dri dang*/ bdug pa dang me tog la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod nas gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bsod nams 'di yis sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes thob par gyur cig ces pas so// de nas longs spyod/ brtag gnyis bzhin rdo rje'i glu dang gar bya/ lhag ma bsdus/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas kha phru btab ste/ hūm̐ ma rdo rje btsun mo khros pa'i gzugs// 'khor gnas dang pho nya 'jig rten pa// dam tshig dang sha za'i ḍā ki ma// mdangs dkar ser dmar ljang sngo dang khra// lus glog 'khyug me dpung 'u ru ru// ngag bshugs glu zhud po di ri ri// yid sangs rgyas bstan la dung nge nge*// las srid gsum myul la sha ra ra// mtho nam mkha'i dbyings nas bya ra byed/ dam nyams pa'i steng du thog tu 'bab// bar dur khrod kun tu rgyu zhing 'phur// dgra tho lum 'bar ba'i ro ru za// dma' rgya mtsho'i klong nas gyen du rgyug /mi dam nyams bsgral nas khrag la 'thung*// nad brgyad khri bzhi stong kun gyi bdag /pho mtshar po kun gyi snying la 'jug /mo mtshar mo thams cad zhe yis gnon// gnas dben par bsgom ba'i drod tshad myul// khyed dgyes pa'i lhag gtor bshams nas 'bul// nged skal ldan dga' ba'i dngos grub zhu// oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa bh+yaḥswāhā/

tshogs zhing gtor mgron ye shes pa// oṃ khyed kyis sogs rdo rje bsdus ba'i phyag rgyas rang ngam rten la bsdu/ 'jig rten pa sarba gats+tshas se gol brdabs te gshegs/ gzhon nu ma'i tshogs mchod pa yang nus na bya'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
